{{Top|leg}}
'''Ilinium''' was a substance used for making prosthetics.<ref name="invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> 

In [[41 ABY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]] had an ilinium prosthetic fitted into his kneecap.<ref name="invincible" />
